column1: # Way files as the builder's encoder writes them (builder/src/way_files.h): what the case covers,
# the kind (street or interp), the logical ways (name_id or street_id, start_number,
# end_number, interpolation, and the nodes as lat:lng f32 bits in hex joined by |, - for none;
# ways joined by ;, - for no ways), and the rows file and the nodes file as hex. A street's
# numbers are 0 and not stored. The builder's tests encode the ways to the files and decode
# them back; the server's read the ways from the files and its test encoder (way_files.rs)
